newsitem.title: USA: Horizon Mental to buy Specialty Healthcare.
newsitem.headline: Horizon Mental to buy Specialty Healthcare.

text.p: Horizon Mental Health Management Inc said it signed a definitive agreement to buy privately held Specialty Healthcare Management Inc of Englewood, Colorado for for 1.65 million shares of Horizon's common stock.
The number of shares, which could decrease under certain circumstances, represents about 20 percent of Horizon's common stock on a fully diluted basis after the deal is completed.

Based on Horizon's Friday closing price of $15.375, the deal is worth roughly $25 million. The tax-free stock exchange would be accounted for as a pooling of interests in which Specialty would become a subsidiary of Horizon.

Specialty is a contract manager of mental health, physical rehabilitation and chemical dependency treatment programs for general acute care hospitals and other health care entities. It has 46 management contracts with general hospitals in 21 states, Horizon said in a statement.

For the year ended December 31, 1996, Specialty reported revenues of $33.8 million and net income of $1.2 million. For the six months ended February 28, 1997 it posted revenues of $15.9 million and net income of $805,000.
